deadline.value: Fall priority deadline is January 31; the final Fall deadline is April 1.

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required, but good scores can strengthen the application.
gre_general.quote: The Graduate Record Examination (GRE) is not required

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The page does not say a faculty agreement is needed before admission.

funding.value: All admitted students receive a research assistant stipend and full tuition waivers.
funding.quote: Yes, all admitted students will receive a Research Assistant Stipend

entry_route.value: A four-year bachelor's degree is the stated requirement; the page does not require a master's.
entry_route.quote: Completion of a four-year Bachelor’s degree or equivalent from a recognized college or university
